title: Photobiomodulation for genitourinary syndrome of menopause
author: Pei-Chi Wu

steps.title: Configure Device Parameters
steps.instruction: Set the TI-816-12 AlGaInP semiconductor diode laser (Transverse Industries Co., Ltd, Taiwan) to the following operational specifications:

substeps.instruction: Set center wavelength to 660 nm (±10nm spectral bandwidth).
Set operating mode to Pulsed at a frequency of 20 Hz.
Set pulse on duration to 0.025 sec (50% duty cycle).
Ensure energy per pulse is 0.0184 J.

steps.title: Apply Photobiomodulation Treatment
steps.instruction: Administer the laser treatment to the whole vaginal mucosa using a silicone light guide vaginal probe via the contact application technique.

substeps.instruction: Irradiate the whole vaginal mucosa (total area of 12cm²).
Maintain exposure for 1800 sec (30 min) per session.
Ensure target irradiance is 32.38 mW/cm² at the tip of the probe and 13.38 mW/cm² at the side of the probe.
Achieve a radiant exposure (fluence) of 29.14 J/cm² for the vaginal fornix and 12.04 J/cm² for the vaginal wall.

steps.title: Complete Treatment Course
steps.instruction: Repeat the treatment session for a total of 8 sessions.

substeps.instruction: Verify radiant energy per session is 178.7 J.
Ensure total radiant energy across all sessions reaches 1429.6 J.
